purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations at the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for 2013, feeding downstream analyses that join flight or operational data to ambient weather conditions by origin and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to other hourly or per-flight records; expect wind_gust to be null in most rows (74.6% null) and treat null wind_dir, wind_speed, and pressure values as missing station readings rather than zero.
limitations: wind_gust is retained despite a 74.6% null rate and should not be relied on for complete coverage; pressure (11.5% null) and wind_dir (1.7% null) also have partial coverage; no exact duplicate rows were found so no rows were removed during cleanup, and year is a constant 2013 across the dataset.
